title: LLM-Enhanced Rumor Detection via Virtual Node Induced Edge Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2602.13279v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The rapid proliferation of rumors on social networks poses a significant threat to information integrity. While rumor dissemination forms complex structural patterns, existing detection methods often fail to capture the intricate interplay between textual coherence and propagation dynamics. Current approaches typically represent nodes through isolated textual embeddings, neglecting the semantic flow across the entire propagation path. To bridge this gap, we introduce a novel framework that integrates Large Language Models (LLMs) as a structural augmentation layer for graph-based rumor detection. Moving beyond conventional methods, our framework employs LLMs to evaluate information subchains and strategically introduce a virtual node into the graph. This structural modification converts latent semantic patterns into explicit topological features, effectively capturing the textual coherence that has historically been inaccessible

translated_title: 基于虚拟节点诱导边预测的大语言模型增强谣言检测
translated_abstract: 谣言在社交网络上的迅速扩散对信息完整性构成了重大威胁。尽管谣言的传播形成了复杂的结构模式，现有的检测方法往往无法捕捉文本连贯性与传播动态之间错综复杂的相互作用。当前方法通常通过孤立的文本嵌入来表示节点，忽略了整个传播路径上的语义流动。为弥合这一差距，我们引入了一种新颖的框架，将大语言模型（LLM）集成为基于图的谣言检测的结构增强层。超越传统方法，我们的框架利用LLM评估信息子链，并有策略地在图中引入一个虚拟节点。这种结构修改将潜在的语义模式转化为显式的拓扑特征，有效捕捉了历来难以获取的文本连贯性。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种将大语言模型作为图结构增强层的谣言检测框架，通过LLM评估信息子链并在图中引入虚拟节点，将潜在语义模式转化为显式拓扑特征，从而捕捉传播路径上的文本连贯性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a rumor detection framework that integrates LLMs as a structural augmentation layer, evaluating information subchains and introducing a virtual node into the graph to convert latent semantic patterns into explicit topological features for capturing textual coherence along propagation paths.
